question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?
sql:
WITH year_top2 AS (
  SELECT 
    ci.db_year,
    c.pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM collisions c
  JOIN case_ids ci ON c.case_id = ci.case_id
  WHERE c.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL 
    AND c.pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY ci.db_year, c.pcf_violation_category
),
top2_years AS (
  SELECT db_year, STRING_AGG(pcf_violation_category, ',' ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS top2_causes
  FROM year_top2
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY db_year
)
SELECT * FROM top2_years ORDER BY db_year;

WITH year_top2 AS (
  SELECT 
    ci.db_year,
    c.pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM collisions c
  JOIN case_ids ci ON c.case_id = ci.case_id
  WHERE c.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL 
    AND c.pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY ci.db_year, c.pcf_violation_category
),
top2_years AS (
  SELECT db_year, STRING_AGG(pcf_violation_category, ',' ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS top2_causes
  FROM year_top2
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY db_year
)
